sections.text_helper: Section 14.3.1 "LPDMA instances" in chapter 14 (Low-power direct memory access controller (LPDMA)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 383.
sections.section_content:
The number of available channels per instance are given in Table86: LPDMA1/2 channels
implementation. Section14.8: LPDMA registers reflects the LPDMA registers, with x = 0 to 7
for the channel number.
LPDMA instances have the same registers, excepted for those with x = 4 to 7.
Any LPDMA instance is connected to the same requests and triggers.
[Table 86. LPDMA1/2 channels implementation]
